evaluator: Blind Stagebench Phase 2 evaluator; measured the published build in headless Chromium with an AnalyserNode/ScriptProcessor tap patched onto AudioNode.prototype.connect at the destination, A/B-ing every effect unit, every listed type and every instrument on real rendered signal.
summary: A genuinely working Phase 2 audio build. One AudioContext, per-layer buses, the documented chain order, master gain + limiter, one destination (measured: 1 context, 1 destination connect). Three real recorded banks (waveform correlation 0.10-0.49 between grand/upright/electric, 17 roots each, 66 valid WAVs, zero network requests after load) and six audibly distinct types. Every effect unit and every listed type measurably changes rendered signal: delay repeats track the tempo knob to within 2 ms, reverb tails run 220-910 ms across the six types, all seven amp types differ. Inputs are excellent: pointer, computer keys, Web MIDI, CC64/Space/UI sustain, per-layer SUSTPED, 36-note polyphony with clean silence afterwards, visible failure state, zero console errors. Weak spots are panel truth and gain staging: type and layer-focus LEDs contradict the actual state, Timbre (including Dyno 1/2) does not measurably change the signal, the model encoder is inert, the compressor mostly adds level, and maxed drive clips the destination at peak 1.41.

criteria.label: Instrument breadth & character
evidence: All six types are audibly distinct in the running build. Spectral centroid at MIDI 60 (4-window averaged FFT on the tapped destination): grand 1634 Hz, upright 479 Hz, electric 550 Hz, clav 1682 Hz, digital 494 Hz, misc 593 Hz. High-band (2-12 kHz) energy separates the acoustic banks clearly: grand 10.84 vs upright 0.80 vs electric 0.35.

The three recorded banks are genuinely different recordings, not one voice relabelled: decoding build/samples/recorded-pcm.json and cross-correlating the MIDI 60 zones gives grand/electric 0.314, grand/upright 0.494, electric/upright 0.106, with source-file centroids 1711 / 477 / 573 Hz.

Bank depth is thin for the hardware: 17 roots (MIDI 36-84, every 3 semitones) at 22.05 kHz, one velocity layer for grand and electric, two for upright (32 zones) - matching the IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS declaration exactly.

Character is simplified in a way a player notices: artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:370-372 loops every sampled voice (loop=true, loopStart 0.14 s), so a held piano note sustains indefinitely at the 28% sustain plateau instead of decaying. Clav is a single square oscillator through a bandpass, Digital four sines, Misc a two-operator FM mallet (piano-engine.ts:399-442).

Levels are not matched across the library: rendered RMS at MIDI 60, velocity 0.85 was 0.0095 (grand) / 0.0114 (upright) / 0.0096 (electric) but 0.0278 (clav), 0.0347 (digital), 0.0212 (misc) - an 11 dB jump when switching from a sampled type to a synthesised one.

criteria.label: Effect audibility & correctness
evidence: Every unit and every listed type was A/B-ed individually on rendered signal and all change it. Mod 1 (amount 0.95, rate 0.6): Tremolo rms 0.0062, Ring Mod 0.0090 with crest 11.0, A-Wah centroid 987 Hz, Wah centroid 2796 Hz, Pump 0.0046, A-Pan stereo (L-R)/L ratio 0.948 versus 0.000 for every other type. Mod 2 all six differ (Chorus c=1757, Flanger 1582, Phaser 1276, Vibe 1634, Ensemble 1629, Spin 1496 Hz, with low-band energy 70/70/104/101/58/115).

Delay is a real delay whose time tracks the knob: envelope-peak spacing measured 430 ms at tempo 0.5 (predicted 60/140 = 428.6 ms) and 250-260 ms at tempo 1.0 (predicted 250 ms). The feedback filter processes the repeats only - tail centroid 1354 Hz (Off), 807 Hz (LP), 1763 Hz (HP), 1789 Hz (BP). Tap tempo at 500 ms intervals produced 500 ms repeat spacing.

Reverb decay grows in the documented order - tail length 220 ms (Booth), 250 ms (Room), 300 ms (Stage), 380 ms (Hall), 910 ms (Cathedral); Spring is distinctly band-limited (low-band 1.01 against mid-band 21.9). Bright/dark moves the tail centroid 2023 Hz -> 1286 Hz; mix 0 removes the tail.

Amp types are not clones: centroid 1665 (Twin) / 1912 (JC) / 1517 (Small); LP24 low-band 492 vs HP24 low-band 0.25. Per-unit bypass and the Layer FX ON all-bypass both work (rms 0.0175 engaged -> 0.0067 bypassed -> restored).

The compressor does not behave like its namesake: at amount 0.95 the velocity 1.0-to-0.2 range narrowed only from 12.46 dB to 10.35 dB while overall level rose 10.15 dB, i.e. it is largely the Blink DynamicsCompressor makeup gain rather than dynamic-range control. Fast mode is measurable (peak 0.227 -> 0.203, crest 6.27 -> 5.63).
Mod 2 Chorus and Ensemble render zero stereo width ((L-R) rms ratio 0.000), so the widening the manual describes is absent; only Mod 1 A-Pan and the rotary path touch the stereo field.

criteria.label: Signal graph & gain staging
evidence: Structure is correct and verified at runtime: patching AudioNode.prototype.connect counted exactly 1 AudioContext and 1 connection to AudioDestinationNode across a full interaction pass. artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:258-268 builds two layer graphs into one master; artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:454-479 orders Mod1 -> Mod2 -> Delay -> Amp/EQ -> Comp -> Reverb -> (rotary send) -> layer level, and effects.ts:751-768 sums into master gain -> DynamicsCompressor limiter (threshold -8 dB, ratio 20) -> destination.

Clipping under load is reproducible: a 10-note chord at velocity 1.0 with Amp drive 1.0, type To Rotary and rotary drive 1.0 rendered destination peak 1.43 and 1.41 in two separate runs (rms 0.61-0.68) - well past full scale despite the limiter. The same chord with effects bypassed peaked at 0.271.

Gain staging is uneven at ordinary settings: enabling Amp/EQ at drive 0.85 raised rendered rms from 0.0118 to 0.0995 (+18.6 dB) and peak to 0.52, because makeDriveCurve applies tanh(x*(1+12*drive)) to a signal already 20 dB below full scale (artifact/src/audio/software-context.ts:705-713 with effects.ts:667).

Cleanup and bypass hygiene are good: 36 simultaneous notes peaked at 0.320 with no clipping, and after release the destination measured rms 0.000000, peak 0.000000. All parameter moves use 12 ms linear ramps (effects.ts:17-28) and toggling reverb mid-note produced no discontinuity spike (peak stayed 0.068).
Master Level reaches the graph but never mutes: rendered hold-window rms 0.01662 / 0.00949 / 0.00197 at knob 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.0, because master gain is 0.12 + level*0.95 (piano-engine.ts:124).

criteria.label: Two-layer piano behaviour
evidence: The audio side is complete. Layer A alone rendered rms 0.01066; enabling B took it to 0.01759; B level 0.0 returned it to 0.01066 and B level 1.0 gave 0.02260. Layer B octave +1 moved the dominant partial to 521.5 Hz while A stayed at 263.7 Hz, and B held type clav (centroid 1838 Hz) while A stayed grand.

FX focus follows layer focus and effects are per layer: with only layer B sounding and Mod 1 Tremolo enabled while layer A was focused, hold-window modulation depth was 0.418 (ungrouped) and 0.894 after pressing FX GROUP - so group mode really copies layer A's chain onto B.

The panel does not reflect focus. Measured aria-pressed after each click: initial A=true/B=false (panel layer A); after clicking B-FOCUS A=true/B=true while the panel switched to B; after one click of A-FOCUS A=false/B=true and the panel still reported layer B; only a second click returned focus to A. Two focus LEDs read lit at once and a single press of the A focus button does nothing audible.

The six piano type LEDs never follow the TYPE button: cycling through all six types (verified by section[data-section=piano] data-piano-type going grand -> upright -> electric -> clav -> digital -> misc) left piano-type-grand aria-pressed=true and the other five false at every step. artifact/src/model/apply-control.ts:165 exports typeLedValues() but nothing imports it.
Piano section ON/OFF is real: with piano-on off the destination rendered rms 0.000000 and peak 0.000000; back on, rms 0.01215.

criteria.label: Detailed piano controls
evidence: KB Touch works: the same velocity-0.3 note rendered hold-window rms 0.00297 (Heavy) / 0.00468 (Medium) / 0.00749 (Light), compressing the loud-to-soft span from 13.44 dB to 5.85 dB.
Dyn Comp works in the documented direction: loud-to-soft range 11.63 dB (Off) -> 7.96 dB (1) -> 2.52 dB (3), raising the soft stroke from 0.00369 to 0.01060 while leaving the loud stroke at ~0.0142.

Unison, Soft Release and String Res all measurably change the signal: unison centroid 1515 / 1660 / 1891 / 1933 Hz for Off/1/2/3 with beating depth rising 0.417 -> 0.565; soft release lengthened the post-release decay from 150-200 ms to 280-320 ms over three trials each; string resonance raised mid-band energy from 17.94 to 25.35.

Timbre does not measurably work. On Grand at MIDI 72, velocity 1.0 (4 shots averaged per setting) the centroid was 2036 Hz (Off), 1949 Hz (Soft), 2024 Hz (Mid), 2177 Hz (Bright), and high-band energy was non-monotonic - Soft 13.15 above Bright 10.70. On Electric the six settings Off/Soft/Mid/Bright/Dyno 1/Dyno 2 gave 743 / 833 / 731 / 844 / 825 / 768 Hz with no ordering at all, i.e. Dyno 1 and Dyno 2 are indistinguishable from Off. The cause is visible at artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:485-495: the cutoff lands at 4.7-13 kHz, above the useful content of a 22.05 kHz sample bank.

The Piano model encoder is inert: apply-control.ts:92 writes layers[focus].model, and grepping the artifact finds no reader anywhere in src/audio or src/components, so turning MODEL changes neither sound nor the Program display (which shows only the type label plus layer).

criteria.label: Input reliability & failure behaviour
evidence: All four input paths drive the same lifecycle. Real Playwright key events on 'q' rendered a note at f0 263.7 Hz with the MIDI-60 key showing aria-pressed=true; an injected Web MIDI 0x90 64 100 rendered f0 328.1 Hz (E4 = 329.6) with the key tracking; 0x90 67 0 was honoured as a note-off (tail decayed to 330 ms); pointer velocity follows the strike position on the key.

Sustain works from all three sources and respects per-layer routing: post-release energy in the 600 ms after note-off was 0.000278 with no pedal, 0.005717 (UI pedal), 0.005874 (Space), 0.006122 (MIDI CC64), and dropped back to 0.001222 with piano SUSTPED off, then 0.005997 when re-enabled.
Space is not swallowed by panel focus: with #reverb-mix focused, holding Space still sustained (post-release energy 0.006521) and left the focused control untouched (aria-valuenow stayed 0.28).

No stuck notes or leaks under stress: 36 held notes rendered peak 0.320 with all 36 keys aria-pressed, and after release the destination measured rms 0.000000 with 0 keys pressed; 40 rapid note pairs rendered cleanly; dispatching window blur mid-note silenced everything (rms 0.000000) and cleared the key state.

Failure degrades visibly rather than silently: with the AudioContext constructor made to throw, the status line reported data-audio-status=error with 'Audio error - labeled fallback is playable (keys still track)', the Program OLED showed 'LOAD FAIL / fallback playable', piano-type-grand carried the is-flash class, and keys still tracked (aria-pressed=true) with no console errors.
Zero console errors and zero failed requests were recorded across every interaction pass in this evaluation.

criteria.label: Required piano instruments
evidence: All six required types are present, selectable from the panel and actually load: cycling the TYPE button through grand/upright/electric/clav/digital/misc produced audio for each, the status line stayed data-audio-status=ready ('Grand/Upright/Electric recorded libraries loaded'), and the Program OLED named Concert Grand / Kawai Upright / Tine EP / Clavinet / Digital / Marimba.

Every bundled audio asset decodes: all 66 WAVs under build/samples (17 grand, 32 upright, 17 electric) parse as valid RIFF PCM16 mono 22.05 kHz with in-range data chunks, and the packed base64 bank build/samples/recorded-pcm.json decodes to 17/32/17 zones over roots 36-84.

The library works offline - after initial page load the browser issued zero further network requests while switching types and playing, because the PCM is inlined in the bundle (artifact/src/audio/samples.ts imports ./recorded-pcm.json synchronously).

Provenance is complete and matches reality: build/samples/LICENSES.md and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json name FluidR3 GM acoustic grand (MIT), FreePats Upright piano KW (CC0) and FluidR3 GM electric piano 1 (MIT), with root and velocity-layer counts that agree with what I decoded.

Coverage stops at one model per type, and the model dial that would select within a type does nothing (see pianoControlDepth), so selection.modelNameShownInProgramDisplay and typeButtonCyclesSixLeds from the piano spec are not met.

criteria.label: Required effect units and types
evidence: Every required unit is on the panel with its parameters - FX1 (on/type/rate/amount), FX2, AMP/EQ (on/type/drive/bass/mid/mid-freq/treble), COMP (on/amount/fast/global), DELAY (on/tempo/feedback/mix/filter/tap/global), REVERB (on/type/mix/bright/global), ROTARY (on/speed/drive), plus FX ON, focus and group (artifact/src/components/sections.tsx:275-340).

Every listed type is reachable by cycling and all are audibly distinct: 6 Mod 1, 6 Mod 2, 7 Amp (including To Rotary, which routes the layer into the rotary - engaging it changed rendered rms 0.0913 -> 0.329 with heavy modulation), 4 delay filter modes and 6 reverb types, all measured above.

Global mode is only partly modelled: with layer A's delay on and only layer B sounding, DELAY GLOBAL extended B's tail from 100 ms to 140 ms, because artifact/src/audio/effects.ts:527-544 only ORs the on-state and still takes each layer's own parameters rather than propagating one setting to all layers of all sections.

The three FX focus buttons are inert: apply-control.ts:62-64 writes state.fxSectionFocus and nothing in the artifact ever reads it, so knob edits always land on the focused piano layer regardless of which focus button is lit.

No unit shows which of its types is selected - the type buttons are plain LED toggles with static labels, so cycling Mod 1 through six types gives no panel readout; likewise the tap tempo changed the audio (500 ms repeats) while the DELAY TEMPO knob stayed at aria-valuenow 0.45.

Rotary is instantiated inside each layer graph (effects.ts:470) rather than as the single shared unit the effects spec specifies; the candidate declares this deviation in evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md. Optional ping-pong and rotary stop are absent.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
evidence: Audio-source honesty is solid and independently verified: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares three recorded banks with roots 36-84 and 1/2/1 velocity layers and declares Clav/Digital/Misc plus the fallback as live oscillators - decoding the shipped PCM confirmed 17/32/17 zones over exactly those roots, and the synthesised types are oscillator-based in piano-engine.ts:399-442. Nothing generated is described as a recording.

The declared decorative sections really are decorative: toggling nine Organ/Synth/Program buttons and sweeping five of their knobs/drawbars to maximum left the rendered note at rms 0.01125 -> 0.01215 and centroid 1616 -> 1533 Hz, i.e. within the shot-to-shot noise of this rig.

IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md ticks all five Phase 2 hard gates, including 'Every functional piano and effect control measurably changes rendered audio and agrees with its panel feedback'. Measurement contradicts that gate on four counts: Timbre and the Dyno settings do not measurably change the signal, the model encoder is inert, the piano type LEDs and layer focus LEDs disagree with the actual state, and the delay tap does not move its knob.

evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md claims 'Per-unit LEDs match processing' and 'OLED now shows the focused piano model name', neither of which holds for type selection or model selection as measured in the running build.

Some deviations are declared well - the per-layer rotary insertion is stated explicitly in the visual audit, and the status line and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS both name Organ/Synth/Program as decorative - but the inert model dial, inert FX focus buttons and reduced global-mode semantics are undeclared.

issues.title: Destination clips at peak 1.41 with drive controls maxed
issues.detail: A 10-note chord at velocity 1.0 with Amp drive 1.0, amp type To Rotary and rotary drive 1.0 rendered destination peak 1.43 and 1.41 across two runs (rms 0.61-0.68). The master DynamicsCompressor limiter (threshold -8 dB, ratio 20, effects.ts:751-768) does not hold the output below full scale, because the drive waveshaper tanh(x*(1+12*drive)) supplies more than 18 dB of gain before it. The same chord bypassed peaks at 0.271.

issues.title: Timbre (and Dyno 1/2) does not measurably change rendered audio
issues.detail: Grand at MIDI 72 velocity 1.0, four shots averaged per setting: centroid 2036 / 1949 / 2024 / 2177 Hz for Off/Soft/Mid/Bright with high-band energy non-monotonic (Soft 13.15 > Bright 10.70). On Electric the six settings gave 743 / 833 / 731 / 844 / 825 / 768 Hz with no ordering, so Dyno 1 and Dyno 2 are indistinguishable from Off. piano-engine.ts:485-495 places the lowpass cutoff at 4.7-13 kHz, above the useful bandwidth of the 22.05 kHz sample bank.

issues.title: Focus and type LEDs contradict the instrument state
issues.detail: After clicking the layer B focus button, both A and B focus LEDs read aria-pressed=true while the panel reported layer B; one click of the A focus button then turned A's LED off without moving focus, and a second click was needed to return. Separately, cycling the TYPE button through all six piano types left piano-type-grand lit and the other five dark at every step - typeLedValues() at apply-control.ts:165 is exported but never imported.

issues.title: Compressor adds level rather than reducing dynamic range
issues.detail: At amount 0.95 the loud-to-soft (velocity 1.0 vs 0.2) span narrowed only from 12.46 dB to 10.35 dB while overall level rose 10.15 dB. The audible result is a volume boost, not the dynamic-range control the manual describes. Fast mode is measurable (peak 0.227 -> 0.203, crest 6.27 -> 5.63).

issues.title: All five Phase 2 hard gates self-certified despite measurable failures
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md marks every hard gate [x], including the requirement that every functional control measurably changes rendered audio and agrees with its panel feedback. Measured counter-examples: Timbre/Dyno, the inert model encoder, the piano type and focus LEDs, and the delay tap knob. The visual audit's claims 'Per-unit LEDs match processing' and 'OLED now shows the focused piano model name' are also not borne out.

issues.title: Piano MODEL encoder is inert and undeclared
issues.detail: apply-control.ts:92 writes layers[focus].model but no code in src/audio or src/components reads it, so the model dial changes neither audio nor the Program display, which always shows the type label. The piano spec's modelDialSelectsWithinType and modelNameShownInProgramDisplay are unmet, and the gap is not declared.

issues.title: FX focus buttons write state nothing reads
issues.detail: apply-control.ts:62-64 sets state.fxSectionFocus from the three focus buttons, but no consumer exists in the artifact; knob edits always target the focused piano layer. Effect focus therefore only follows layer focus, and the manual focus buttons are decorative without being declared as such.

issues.title: No panel readout of the selected effect type, and tap tempo desyncs its knob
issues.detail: Mod 1, Mod 2, Amp, Reverb and the delay filter all cycle through their types via plain LED toggle buttons with static labels, so the player cannot see which of six types is active. Tapping the delay TAP button twice 500 ms apart produced 500 ms repeat spacing in the audio while the DELAY TEMPO knob stayed at aria-valuenow 0.45.

issues.title: Sampled notes loop instead of decaying, and levels jump between types
issues.detail: piano-engine.ts:370-372 sets loop=true with loopStart 0.14 s on every sampled voice, so a held piano note sustains indefinitely at the 28% plateau rather than decaying. Rendered RMS also jumps about 11 dB between sampled types (0.0095-0.0114) and synthesised ones (0.0212-0.0347), so switching type changes loudness as much as timbre.

issues.title: Chorus and Ensemble render no stereo width
issues.detail: Measured (L-R) RMS relative to L was 0.000 for every Mod 2 type including Chorus and Ensemble; only Mod 1 A-Pan (0.948) moves the stereo field. The effects spec describes Chorus as detuned widening and Ensemble as three cross-connected modulated delay lines, both stereo effects on the hardware.

issues.title: Candidate audio tests assert on a self-written simulator, not browser-rendered signal
issues.detail: Every audio test routes through renderPianoScript (piano-engine.ts:607-619), which builds the candidate's own SoftwareAudioContext (src/audio/software-context.ts, 713 lines) under vitest with environment 'jsdom'; no OfflineAudioContext or browser is involved. The suite is therefore not a mock-only suite - it does real DSP - but effect correctness is validated against the candidate's own model, which is how issues such as the inaudible Timbre filter (asserted only as meanAbsDiff > 0.001 in src/piano-velocity-controls.test.ts) pass while failing in the real browser graph.
